Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

Confira esta oportunidade para Full stack developer specialist – node.js / typescript em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Here at Zallpy, technology is born from curious, collaborative people with a desire to do things well. If you like environments where there's room to ask questions, test, learn, and evolve together, check out this opportunity! Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion At Zallpy, we value an environment where everyone can be themselves, with respect, safety, and a sense of belonging. We especially encourage applications from people with disabilities and guarantee an accessible environment with adaptations and support throughout the journey. We also encourage Black people, women, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and professionals from diverse backgrounds to apply. Here, you can be yourself at every stage of your journey. Come join us. We are looking for someone to work in a team that thinks big, works with attention to detail, collaborates daily, and shares responsibility. We believe in autonomy, the exchange of different experiences, and solutions built together. Here, growth means sharing knowledge, respecting different ways of thinking, and building trusting relationships while delivering quality technology. If you identify with this way of working, come join us. What you will do: Develop technical solutions that meet the requirements presented using the technologies involved in the project; Work within agile team structures based on Agile methodologies, with intense information exchange; Participate in ceremonies for defining the product backlog for Sprints, as well as Dailies, Reviews, and Retrospectives; Keep task boards updated regarding pending tasks, ongoing activities, and possible blockers; Use the company's communication tools to stay updated on schedules, alignments, and team discussions; Deliver code covered by unit and integration tests; Submit Pull Requests for team review. What we are looking for: Bachelor's degree in Technology or related fields (ongoing or completed); Experience with version control management using Git and Git Flow; Experience with Docker; Experience in WEB application development using React.js; Experience with front-end componentization; Experience with component styling using styled-components; Experience with unit and integration testing on both front-end and back-end using Jest; Experience in application development using Node.js / Type Script; Experience processing large volumes of transactional data; Experience developing applications with high data volume and asynchronous processing; Experience developing REST API applications; Experience developing applications using Graph QL; Experience developing applications using Mongo DB; Experience developing applications using Postgre SQL; Experience with ETL processes; Experience creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines; Experience with container orchestration using Kubernetes. Nice to have: Experience working with basic Cloud services (EC2, S3, RDS); Advanced knowledge of Design Patterns, including SOLID, Clean Code, etc.; Experience creating and managing Cloud Services (AWS, Azure); Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) using Terraform, Consul, AWS, Azure, or similar technologies; Previous experience as a Tech Lead or Software Architect; Experience with database migration between Mongo DB and Postgre SQL. Where you will work: This is a 100% remote position. Hiring models: CLT Cooperative Benefits of being a Zallper: Meal/Food Allowance Caju multi-benefit card (credit format), offering flexibility for everyday needs. (CLT only) * Health Plan – Unimed No waiting period or copayment for the holder. Possibility to include dependents (children, spouse, or stepchildren) with copayment. (CLT only) * Dental Plan – Uniodonto Affordable options to include dependents. (CLT only) * Wellhub Access to gyms, physical activities, and wellness programs. Zenklub For CLT: Two free sessions per month and special rates for additional sessions. For Cooperative/Contractor: Special rates for sessions. Life Insurance More security for you and your family. (CLT only) * Childcare Allowance Financial support for Zallpers with children from 4 months to 6 years old, according to internal policy. (CLT only) * Baby Zallpy A special gift to celebrate the arrival of new Zallpy babies. Business Partner Support Close and human-centered support from our People & Culture team throughout your journey at Zallpy. Volunteer Internal Communities Diversity, Sports & Movement, and Technology. Educational Partnerships Discounts on undergraduate and graduate programs, professional courses, and language schools. Experiences & Development Participation in events, workshops, trips, and team-building activities. Referral Program Refer talents to Zallpy and receive bonuses from R$2,500 to R$5,000. * Contractor / PJ: For these hiring models, the benefits above apply except for those marked with an asterisk (*), which are exclusive to CLT. In addition, we offer dedicated platforms to manage contractors, ensuring organization, transparency, and a structured experience throughout the entire journey.

title: Senior golang engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior golang engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a global leader in the meal kit delivery industry that helps millions of customers cook healthy, homemade meals without the stress of meal planning or grocery shopping. As part of Zoolatech's distributed engineering team, you will join the Market Innovation team - a fast-moving internal innovation group focused on building and delivering new product initiatives across multiple domains and services. Unlike traditional product teams, this team operates across different repositories, architectures, and backend ecosystems, taking ownership of complex discovery-driven projects from investigation to MVP delivery. By joining Zoolatech, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership and global stakeholders in a highly autonomous environment that values ownership, adaptability, strong communication, and engineering curiosity. Responsibilities Investigate and understand existing backend services and distributed systems Design and implement backend solutions primarily using Golang Work on MVP delivery from technical discovery through implementation Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple domains and teams Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture Skills Required Strong commercial experience with Golang Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, Rabbit MQ, or AWS SQS/SNS Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing Strong knowledge of relational databases Ability to quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases and services Strong problem-solving and backend investigation skills Good communication skills and ability to work independently English level sufficient for direct communication with international teams Nice to Have Experience with Python Familiarity with Mongo DB, Elasticsearch, Graph QL, or JVM languages Experience working in fast-paced MVP or startup-like environments Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully) This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider. To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country. Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bookkeeper em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We've intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work. At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive. We're now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You'll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support. What You'll Do Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close. Maintain accurate financial data using Quick Books or other cloud-based accounting tools. Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions. Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace. Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines. Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency. Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes. Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core's quality expectations. What We're Looking For Fluent in English Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time) Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools. Nice to Have Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana Prior experience working with startups or small businesses Why You'll Love Working With Us At Aerial Core, we do things differently: Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload. Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we'll support it. Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success. Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You'll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained. The Aerial Core Way Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value. Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights. Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth. Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care. Ready to do accounting differently? Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Senior it technical recruiter – latam based
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior it technical recruiter – latam based em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Aptonet Inc. is seeking experienced Senior IT Technical Recruiters to join our world-class recruiting team. This role is based in Latin America (LATAM) and will focus on sourcing, screening, and placing top technical talent. You will recruit LATAM-based candidates for U. S.-based companies and also support U. S.-based recruiting efforts for our U. S. clients. Our recruiting team builds the foundation of our clients' success by connecting them with extraordinary talent who share our vision and values. What We Look For 3-5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in an agency setting or a high-growth tech environment. Proven experience recruiting for diverse Information Technology roles. Understanding of technology trends and a passion for working with technical professionals. Strong ability to multi-task, manage multiple roles, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication skills – both written and verbal – in English; Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus. High level of professionalism, integrity, and customer service focus. Proficiency with tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and modern ATS systems. What You'll Be Doing Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including sourcing, screening, interviews, feedback, offers, and onboarding. Build strong pipelines of both LATAM and U. S.-based technical candidates using creative sourcing strategies. Leverage a variety of sourcing tools, including internet research, Boolean search strings, Linked In, ATS mining, and cold calling. Evaluate applicants by comparing qualifications to job requirements and conducting initial screening interviews. Post job advertisements across relevant platforms such as Linked In, Dice, Career Builder, and niche tech sites. Partner closely with hiring managers and internal teams to understand role requirements and deliver top candidates quickly. Maintain data accuracy in the ATS and track recruiting metrics for reporting and continuous improvement. Develop scalable recruiting processes to support the growth of our recruiting operations in LATAM and the U. S. Act as a trusted representative of Aptonet, promoting our values and delivering a high-quality experience to both candidates and clients.

title: Data annotator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data annotator em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who is Blueprint Technologies? We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States and an expanding footprint across Latin America (LATAM). Our teams are united by a shared passion for solving complex problems. At Blueprint, we use technology as a bridge between strategy and execution. Our people bring diverse perspectives, deep expertise, and real-world experience across industries to help organizations grow, transform, and innovate. About the Role We are seeking detail-oriented Labelers / Annotators to evaluate responses generated by AI systems across multiple languages. This role focuses on side-by-side (SBS) evaluation of outputs from different AI models across real-world scenarios. You will play a key role in improving how AI systems understand and communicate across languages and cultures. This is not a translation role. It is an evaluation and analysis role requiring strong judgment and attention to detail. Language Requirement Fluency in English + at least one of the following languages: Chinese (Simplified and/or Traditional) Japanese Korean Italian German French What You'll Work On You will evaluate AI responses across scenarios such as: General-purpose Q& A Web search results File-based and image-based responses Image and file generation tasks Single-turn and multi-turn conversations Responsibilities Perform side-by-side (SBS) comparisons of AI-generated responses Evaluate outputs based on: Accuracy Relevance Clarity Instruction-following Identify nuances in tone, meaning, and cultural context across languages Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines Maintain consistency and high-quality evaluations Required Qualifications Professional fluency in English + at least one target language listed above Prior experience with side-by-side (SBS) labeling or annotation Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail Ability to quickly understand and apply structured evaluation frameworks Preferred Qualifications Background in linguistics, translation, or localization Experience in: AI evaluation Data annotation Search relevance or content quality analysis Compensation We offer competitive compensation aligned with local markets and experience. Estimated hourly range: R$75 – R$85 BRL Estimated monthly equivalent (full-time): R$12,000 – R$13,600 BRL Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. Training & Qualification All new hires will complete a structured onboarding program, including: Training sessions and practice exercises Calibration against quality benchmarks Qualification review before moving into production work Benefits & Employment Structure This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner, ensuring full compliance with local labor laws and payroll requirements. Employees receive locally compliant benefits, which may include: Statutory benefits (e.g., paid leave, 13th salary where applicable) Social security and healthcare contributions Additional benefits aligned with local market practices Why Blueprint? Work on cutting-edge AI systems Be part of a global, multilingual team Build highly transferable AI evaluation skills Contribute directly to improving real-world AI experiences Equal Opportunity Employer Blueprint Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, or any other protected status.

title: Psiquiatra
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Psiquiatra em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. VAGA PARA MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA — ATENDIMENTO ONLINEA Dr Psiq está em expansão e busca médicos(as) psiquiatras comprometidos(as), éticos(as) e responsáveis para atuação em telemedicina, realizando atendimentos psiquiátricos por vídeo em nossa plataforma digital. Buscamos profissionais que compreendam que a psiquiatria vai além da capacidade técnica: valorizamos médicos humanizados, pontuais, comprometidos com seus pacientes e responsáveis com os horários e agendas disponibilizados. Principais atividades Realização de consultas psiquiátricas por vídeo; Avaliação diagnóstica e acompanhamento terapêutico; Elaboração de planos terapêuticos individualizados; Atendimento de adolescentes, adultos e idosos; Evolução em prontuário eletrônico; Emissão e assinatura digital de documentos médicos; Participação no cuidado contínuo e promoção da saúde mental dos pacientes. Requisitos obrigatórios
Graduação em Medicina; CRM ativo e regular; Formação em Psiquiatria através de: Residência Médica com RQE ativo; ou Pós-graduação em Psiquiatria reconhecida; Experiência em atendimento psiquiátrico; Boa comunicação e postura ética; Comprometimento com agendas e horários disponibilizados para atendimento; Possuir certificado digital válido (e-CPF ou equivalente) para inserção na plataforma e assinatura eletrônica de documentos médicos. Documentação obrigatóriaO profissional deverá apresentar: Currículo atualizado; Documento de identificação profissional; CRM ativo; Certidão de regularidade do Conselho Regional de Medicina; Comprovante de quitação da anuidade do CRM; Certidão ético-profissional emitida pelo CRM; Documentação comprobatória da especialização em Psiquiatria; RQE (quando aplicável); Certificado digital válido para utilização na plataforma. Processo seletivoApós análise curricular e documental, o profissional passará por entrevista de habilitação junto à equipe da clínica para avaliação do perfil profissional, disponibilidade e alinhamento com o modelo de atendimento da instituição. Toda a documentação deverá ser encaminhada para o e-mail: Após o envio da documentação, o candidato deverá entrar em contato com o suporte da clínica através do Whats App: informando o interesse na vaga para que seja direcionado(a) ao setor responsável pelo processo de habilitação profissional. Diferenciais Experiência em psiquiatria da infância e adolescência; Conhecimentos em psicofarmacologia e neurociência; Formação complementar em psicoterapia; Fluência em outros idiomas; Disponibilidade para educação continuada. Modelo de atuação
Atendimento 100% online; Plataforma própria de teleconsulta fornecida pela clínica; Flexibilidade de agenda; Remuneração por percentual das consultas realizadas; Parte do valor da consulta destinada à clínica e parte repassada ao profissional. A clínica prioriza profissionais organizados e comprometidos com o funcionamento operacional dos atendimentos. Por isso, é indispensável que o médico: Mantenha disponibilidade regular no Whats App para comunicação com a equipe da clínica; Acompanhe frequentemente a plataforma e o site para verificar consultas agendadas; Responda aos chamados administrativos e assistenciais dentro de prazo razoável; Cumpra impreterivelmente os horários e agendas disponibilizados para atendimento. O que esperamos do profissionalMais do que títulos e currículo, buscamos médicos comprometidos com: Responsabilidade profissional; Pontualidade e organização; Cumprimento rigoroso das agendas; Respeito aos pacientes; Ética e humanização no atendimento; Continuidade e qualidade assistencial.

title: Linux systems engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Linux systems engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Linux Systems Engineer Embedded, Io T & Edge Infrastructure DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux SENIORITY: Mid · Senior EXPERIENCE: 3+ years STACK FOCUS: Yocto · Web Kit 01 About the role We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too. 02 What you'll own Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. Web Kit-based rendering (WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints. 03 What you bring MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs. NICE BONUS SIGNAL Web Kit on embedded — WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG web OS, Samsung Tizen, Bright Sign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, m DNS. Security hardening / secure boot. 04 The kind of engineer this work asks for Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly. On hardware they weren't designed for APPLY Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

title: Senior outsystems engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior outsystems engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Out Systems Engineer About the Role We are seeking a Senior Out Systems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom-built solution. This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance. What You'll Do Stabilize and Modernize Architecture Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows Optimize Database and System Performance Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database Replace inefficient polling with event-driven or conditional patterns Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health Build a Real Release Pipeline Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline Configure deployment automation using Out Systems APIs Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities Remove unused or redundant components Define governance for capacity-impacting changes Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes Map data entities into portable schemas Capture business logic embedded within the platform Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows What You Bring Required Experience 5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale Out Systems applications Deep experience with Out Systems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within Out Systems Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments Preferred Experience Experience supporting or leading Out Systems to custom title: Ai development orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai development orchestrator em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote Type: Full-Time Reports to: CEO Stack: Type Script, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, Postgre SQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating Saa S, active production users Start: Immediate The Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2 B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15 M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2 E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. Postgre SQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. Type Script primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, Hub Spot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or Web Sockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product Saa S background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent Postgre SQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty. What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15 M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you. To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

About the Role The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, Git Hub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms. Required Skills ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows. What Success Looks Like Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‐technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‐moving, ambiguous environments. description:

Vaga: Enfermeiro(a) — Programa Enfermeiro sem Fronteiras Salário: R$14.500,00 (2.500 euros — inicial) + benefícios Localidade: Alemanha (Berlim, Munique ou outras cidades com demanda hospitalar — a definir conforme colocação) Programa: Enfermeiro sem Fronteiras, da Sprache& Wissen Como funciona? Você participa de um processo seletivo e, se aprovado(a), se inscreve para estudar alemão por até 2 anos na maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, até atingir o nível B2 (final do intermediário). Antes de iniciar seus estudos, você recebe um contrato com garantia de emprego na Alemanha, com cláusulas específicas e seguras — desde que cumpra os requisitos do programa. Se a S& W não conseguir sua colocação após você atingir o B2, o valor investido é devolvido integralmente. Durante todo o período de estudo, você conta com mentoria direcionada da Sprache& Wissen. Quem é a Sprache& Wissen? A Sprache& Wissen (S& W) é uma empresa brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S& W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, com a meta de capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%. Principais atividades (na Alemanha): Cuidado direto ao paciente em ambiente hospitalar ou clínico Administração de medicamentos e acompanhamento de tratamentos Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregador Requisitos: Diploma de Enfermagem (bacharelado) reconhecido no Brasil Idade máxima de 36 anos (requisito do programa de visto alemão) Disponibilidade para estudar alemão por até 2 anos até o nível B2, com flexibilidade de horários Comprometimento com a carga horária do curso e as etapas do programa Documentação em dia para solicitação de visto (passaporte válido ou possibilidade de emitir) Diferenciais: Conhecimento prévio de alemão (qualquer nível) Experiência em UTI, emergência ou centro cirúrgico Experiência internacional ou intercâmbio Inglês intermediário ou avançado Sobre o período de estudos (home office): O curso de alemão é 100% online — você estuda do Brasil enquanto se prepara Mentoria gratuita em grupo durante toda a jornada até o B2 Flexibilidade para conciliar com seu emprego atual Etapas do processo: Inscrição e triagem inicial Entrevista com o time da S& W Aprovação de ficha e documentações Assinatura do contrato com garantia de emprego Matrícula no curso de alemão (até o nível B2) Match com recrutador alemão Colocação profissional na Alemanha

Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS:* Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES: Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA. Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia. Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos.. Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: REMOTO IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Senior golang engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior golang engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a global leader in the meal kit delivery industry that helps millions of customers cook healthy, homemade meals without the stress of meal planning or grocery shopping. As part of Zoolatech's distributed engineering team, you will join the Market Innovation team - a fast-moving internal innovation group focused on building and delivering new product initiatives across multiple domains and services. Unlike traditional product teams, this team operates across different repositories, architectures, and backend ecosystems, taking ownership of complex discovery-driven projects from investigation to MVP delivery. By joining Zoolatech, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership and global stakeholders in a highly autonomous environment that values ownership, adaptability, strong communication, and engineering curiosity. Responsibilities Investigate and understand existing backend services and distributed systems Design and implement backend solutions primarily using Golang Work on MVP delivery from technical discovery through implementation Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple domains and teams Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture Skills Required Strong commercial experience with Golang Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, Rabbit MQ, or AWS SQS/SNS Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing Strong knowledge of relational databases Ability to quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases and services Strong problem-solving and backend investigation skills Good communication skills and ability to work independently English level sufficient for direct communication with international teams Nice to Have Experience with Python Familiarity with Mongo DB, Elasticsearch, Graph QL, or JVM languages Experience working in fast-paced MVP or startup-like environments Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully) This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider. To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country. Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

title: Engenheiro de dados pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de dados pleno em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Data EX: Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a Data EX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA, com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks, atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida, com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar. Contexto do Projeto: Estamos coletando perfis com foco em Engenharia de Dados em ambientes Azure/Fabric para atuação em projetos rotativos de Delivery. Perfil técnico esperado: Experiência comprovada em linguagens de programação como Python e Py Spark. Forte conhecimento de SQL e bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais. Experiência com ferramentas de ETL e frameworks de Big Data (Microsoft Fabric, Spark e Databricks). Conhecimento de serviços em nuvem (Azure). Conhecimentos em Performance de queries SQL. Diferenciais: Certificações: Azure Data Fundamental (AZ900), Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP203), Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600) e/ou Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700) Inglês intermediário - avançado Escopo de Atuação: Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados complexos e eficientes, de uma gama de origens estruturadas e não estruturadas, em Streaming ou Batches. Projetar, implementar e otimizar lakehouses, bancos de dados e data warehouses. Trabalhar em migrações de sistemas legados para sistemas modernos. Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados e garantir sua disponibilidade e performance. Realizar assessment de ambientes analíticos. Colaborar com cientistas e analistas de dados para entender e suportar necessidades de dados. Monitorar e resolver problemas de desempenho e qualidade dos dados.

title: Desenvolvedor salesforce sênior | front-end
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor salesforce sênior | front-end em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você busca novos desafios e deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e inovador, essa oportunidade é para você! Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Salesforce apaixonado por tecnologia e soluções de CRM, que queira contribuir com seu conhecimento e crescer junto com a nossa equipe. Objetivo do Cargo: Atuar no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de soluções na plataforma Salesforce, garantindo qualidade, segurança e aderência às necessidades do negócio. O profissional será responsável por ter conhecimento sólido nas funcionalidades nativas, preocupação com UX, governança e escalabilidade da solução, visão funcional das integrações, entendendo contratos, regras e impactos entre sistemas, atuando com autonomia compatível ao nível pleno. O que você vai fazer no dia a dia? Desenvolver e customizar aplicações na plataforma Salesforce (Apex, Visualforce, Lightning) Realizar integrações entre Salesforce e outros sistemas (APIs REST/SOAP, middleware), com suporte quando necessário Elaborar e manter documentação técnica e funcional dos projetos Propor melhorias e automações nos processos de negócio (Flow) Garantir a qualidade do código e aderência às melhores práticas (Code Review, padrões e guidelines) Participar de reuniões técnicas e de levantamento de requisitos Realizar testes unitários e funcionais das soluções desenvolvidas Apoiar a identificação e correção de incidentes, escalonando quando necessário Contribuir para o cumprimento de SLAs e boas práticas de desenvolvimento O que esperamos de você? Conhecimentos técnicos obrigatórios: Experiência prática: Mínimo de 3 anos atuando exclusivamente como Desenvolvedor Salesforce. Integração & APIs: Vivência com APIs REST/SOAP e consumo de serviços externos, considerando autenticação (OAuth) e tratamento de erros. Engenharia de Software: Aplicação de princípios de Clean Code, noções de SOLID e testes unitários (TDD é desejável). Dados: Conhecimento de SOQL/SOSL e modelagem de dados em Salesforce. Automação de Processos: Conhecimento em Flow. Dev Ops & CI/CD: Vivência com SFDX (Salesforce CLI) e uso de repositórios Git; contato com pipelines (Azure Dev Ops/Git Hub Actions/Flosum) é desejável. Metodologias Ágeis: Vivência em ambientes Scrum, Kanban ou SAFe. Inglês Técnico: Capacidade de leitura de documentação e acompanhamento de referências técnicas. Front-end/usabilidade: UX/UI dentro do Salesforce; Customização de páginas Lightning; Design de jornadas e experiência do usuário; Componentização e responsividade; Experiência com LWC, Aura e estrutura visual da Lightning Experience; Construção de interfaces voltadas para usabilidade e produtividade operacional. Conhecimentos técnicos desejáveis: Formação Acadêmica: Superior em TI, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. Certificações Salesforce: Platform Developer I (desejável) e/ou App Builder. Setor Regulado: Vivência em ambientes de Seguros, Previdência ou Setor Financeiro. Cloud Híbrida: Familiaridade com serviços da Azure (Functions, App Services) integrados ao Salesforce. Gestão de Identidade e Acesso: Vivência na configuração de perfis, permission sets e compartilhamento, garantindo segurança e aderência às regras de acesso. Diferenciais que podem te destacar: Ensino superior em Administração, Engenharia de sistemas ou Tecnologia da Informação; Certificação Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant; Experiência com Salesforce e Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Lean, Kanban, SAFe etc.); Experiência com indicadores de CRM; Experiência com modelo arquitetural REST/SOAP; Inglês intermediário; Experiência com o mercado Segurador, Previdenciário e/ou Financeiro. Habilidades comportamentais que valorizamos: Trabalho em equipe e colaboração; Comprometimento e engajamento; Comunicação eficaz e organização; Disciplina e foco; Raciocínio lógico e resolução de problemas; Proatividade e aprendizado contínuo. Por que se juntar ao nosso time? Ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e inovador; Oportunidade de aprendizado e desenvolvimento profissional; Cultura de colaboração e crescimento conjunto; Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta. Modelo de contratação: PJ Jornada: 168 horas/mês Se identificou com essa oportunidade? Então, não perca tempo! Envie seu currículo e venha construir sua história com a gente!

Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth. Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care. Ready to do accounting differently? Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Risk management officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Risk management officer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class. Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner. As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space. Key Responsibilities: Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks. Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations. Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions. Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including; Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements Net-worth monitoring; Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board. Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations. Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters. Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies. Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management. Requirements: Legally resident in Brazil. Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms. Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English. Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent; unblemished reputation; knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities; technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Paid ads qa auditor - global em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you obsessive about catching what others miss? Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look? Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems? Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away? If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA role. At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry. Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients' brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously. This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent. This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error. However, it is not a "task-ing" role, or a role where you'll be constantly told what to do - you'll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems. ** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY ** You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions: Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first. Then reply to the ad, stating you've completed the Willo, and we will be in touch. Key Responsibilities Include: Campaign Audit & Validation Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, Linked In, Tik Tok, streaming platforms, and others Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity Identify discrepancies such as: Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations Inconsistent implementation across platforms Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup Budget & Pacing Verification Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly Tracking, Links & Technical QA Verify accuracy and functionality of: URLs and landing pages UTM parameters and tracking links Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable) Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistencies Instruction Fidelity & Change Validation Compare campaign execution against: Internal strategy direction Client Success Manager requests Campaign updates or pivots Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely Audit Documentation & Communication Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error) Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution Audit Operations (Evolving Scope) This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including: Audit Cadence: Pre-launch validation Post-launch verification Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits Audit Coverage: Full account audits Targeted sampling across accounts Audit Depth: Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links) Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy) Ownership Scope: Identifying and flagging discrepancies Recommending corrective actions Supporting enforcement of quality standards Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must: Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments Have strong written communication skills Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment Preferred Experience: Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking) Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.) Nice to Have: Salesforce or CRM familiarity Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards Experience documenting processes or building SOPs Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required): Meta Ads Manager Google Ads Google Tag Manager (GTM) Tik Tok Ads Linked In Ads Trade Desk Why Our Work Matters: Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn't teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn't enough. That's where Crisp comes in. We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it's a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors. Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably. S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022). We've helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue. title: Linux systems engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Linux systems engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Linux Systems Engineer Embedded, Io T & Edge Infrastructure DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux SENIORITY: Mid · Senior EXPERIENCE: 3+ years STACK FOCUS: Yocto · Web Kit 01 About the role We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too. 02 What you'll own Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. Web Kit-based rendering (WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints. 03 What you bring MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs. NICE BONUS SIGNAL Web Kit on embedded — WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG web OS, Samsung Tizen, Bright Sign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, m DNS. Security hardening / secure boot. 04 The kind of engineer this work asks for Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly. On hardware they weren't designed for APPLY Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

title: Designer de apresentações (pleno/sênior) - banco de talentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer de apresentações (pleno/sênior) - banco de talentos em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos: A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência. O que buscamos: Estamos em busca de um Designer de Apresentações com forte experiência em criação de layouts, templates e narrativas visuais, capaz de seguir guidelines de marca com excelência estética e transformar conteúdos complexos, incluindo materiais médicos e científicos, em apresentações claras, estratégicas e visualmente atraentes. Procuramos um profissional com domínio de Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, olhar apurado para hierarquia visual, acessibilidade e storytelling, habilidade para resolver problemas de design com agilidade e interesse constante por novas tendências e ferramentas inovadoras. Inglês fluente é mandatório pois trabalhamos em projetos internacionais com times globais. Responsabilidades: Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas, dinâmicas e visualmente sofisticadas, garantindo consistência com as diretrizes de marca, excelência estética e adaptação para diferentes formatos e dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile); Atuar em reuniões de briefing e colaborar diretamente com stakeholders para transformar informações complexas em storytelling claros, objetivos e visualmente impactantes; Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão; Gerenciar o processo de desenvolvimento de apresentações do início ao fim, incluindo alinhamento com stakeholders, construção da narrativa, criação de layouts, incorporação de feedbacks e cumprimento de prazos; Ser responsável pela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações; Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado. Requerimentos & Skills: Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Design de Apresentações, com formação superior (bacharelado) em Design, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas; Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo Power Point, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. Espera-se domínio de hierarquia visual, organização da informação, escolha adequada de visualizações, simplificação de conteúdos densos e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma intuitiva para diferentes públicos. Conhecimento em animação e construção de apresentações interativas, utilizando transições e motion design para criar narrativas visuais fluidas, dinâmicas e envolventes Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição visual, como Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator e In Design) e/ou Figma, para criação e refinamento de assets gráficos, layouts e materiais de apoio Conhecimento de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas à automação e otimização de processos criativos, como Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Gamma, Adobe Firefly e recursos de IA integrados ao Photoshop Forte repertório em design gráfico, com domínio de tipografia, teoria das cores, hierarquia visual, contraste, grids/alinhamentos e princípios de composição, além de olhar apurado para criar materiais limpos, sofisticados e profissionais; Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e gerenciamento de projetos, com capacidade para atuar em múltiplas demandas simultaneamente; Inglês avançado/fluente. Está preparado(a) para cultivar novas experiências em um time que joga junto e valoriza o melhor de cada um(a)? #VEMSERSTUDIORX -- Consideramos todas as aplicações para nossas vagas sem distinção de gênero, orientação sexual, etnia, cultura, origem, religião, deficiência, idade etc. Acreditamos na construção de um mundo mais diverso, com mais representatividade e livre de preconceitos. Aqui você encontra um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e inclusivo que promove o desenvolvimento por meio das conexões humanas!

title: Us payroll analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Us payroll analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The main objective of this role is to review payroll data and documentation for assigned clients, ensuring that all values are accurate based on employees worked hours, guaranteeing traceability and providing consistent, value-added support to clients. Responsibilities: Review quarterly and annual reports to ensure proper submission of payroll records to the IRS. Input client-reported information for payroll processing. Follow up with clients through meetings and emails to ensure that the information entered into ADP/Accountants World is accurate. Enter information into the Accountants World platform for quarterly clients. Review 1099 forms annually in accordance with information provided by Account Managers. Perform all tasks related to the role based on knowledge and capabilities. Education: Bachelor's degree in business administration, Accounting, or related fields. Experience: Minimum of 1 year supporting US payroll processes. Advanced English level – required. Advanced Portuguese level – required. Skills: Customer Orientation Attention to Detail Learning Agility Communication Teamwork

description:

Experiência com orquestração em nuvem com ferramentas como airflow, data factory, Databricks pipelines. Experiência em com Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes ou ferramentas como Azure Container Apps (ou relativas). Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.g., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
